title: Walgreens Reviews Scraper
description: Scrape product reviews from Walgreens.com. Provide a full Walgreens product page URL to extract all reviews, ratings, and review metadata via the Bazaarvoice API.

url.title: Walgreens Product URL
url.description: Full URL of the Walgreens product page (e.g., https://www.walgreens.com/store/c/nivea-men-maximum-hydration-nourishing-body-lotion-aloe-vera/ID=prod6177789-product).

results_wanted.title: Maximum reviews
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect. Defaults to 20; increase this value to collect more reviews.

max_pages.title: Max API pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of API pages to fetch (1 page = up to 100 reviews). Caps pagination regardless of results_wanted.

include_ratings_only.title: Include ratings-only reviews
include_ratings_only.description: When disabled, written reviews are preferred. If a product has no written reviews, the Actor automatically falls back to ratings-only entries so the run still returns data. Enable to always include star-only ratings.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Walgreens reviews are fetched directly by default. Configure Apify Proxy or your own proxy URLs only if direct access is unreliable.
